name: Elsight Limited
summary: Elsight Limited engages in the development and commercialization of the connectivity solutions in Europe, Israel, the United States, and internationally. The company offers Halo platform, a drone connectivity platform serving mission-critical applications across the defense, homeland security (HLS), and uncrewed systems. It also provides AllSight, a one-stop cloud-based software solution for unmanned vehicles that ease the use of the Halo for all Elsight customers; and HeatSight, that offers unparalleled cellular network coverage mapping to optimize flight paths.
